actual_findings.version_limit: The saved node Version field already exists. It is a controller-reported daemon version, not a hash/build proof for a local executable.
actual_findings.failed_job_integer_zero_is_not_mapping_p: The old job records scheduler IDX0, selectors0 and a physical minor0. Matching numbers do not replace the missing actual Slurm File-roster proof.

concrete_corrections_to_original_proposa.before: Installed UVA version described only as not recorded by completed observer.
concrete_corrections_to_original_proposa.after: Use the already retained node-reported23.11.6 as the candidate source version, while still requiring actual binary/package/build/manual proof.

concrete_corrections_to_original_proposa.before: The first proposed print child is an unbound installed slurmd -G -f /etc/slurm/slurm.conf.
concrete_corrections_to_original_proposa.after: First observe installed files/configuration and any existing daemon startup GRES records without executing -G or loading NVML. Only a later reviewed exact-version scope can consider the print child.

concrete_corrections_to_original_proposa.before: Generic print-and-exit wording could imply no pre-print daemon/plugin initialization.
concrete_corrections_to_original_proposa.after: Matching upstream23.11.6 reaches cgroup initialization and configuration/logging work before its GRES print branch. Treat this as a concrete read-only scope concern, not an automatic safe CLI.

primary_source_findings.finding: Version parsing exits before configuration setup. The GRES print path loads configuration, auth/hash and cgroup first, calls the GRES loader, and exits zero without returning that loader status. Configuration reading calls logging and stepd-logging routines.
The cgroup plugin initializer has slurmd system-scope and manual-start migration paths. A read-only claim needs the installed exact branch and build behavior, not just the CLI name.
The printed Index derives from trailing file digits. Device bitmap position is a separate counter while consuming ordered records. Keep printed record order and filename/minor/bitmap fields separate.
The matching manual describes selected configuration input, merged GRES printing and version printing. It does not certify absence of initialization side effects.

The plugin contains GPU metadata and separate process-accounting interfaces. A later runtime call graph must exclude process-accounting and control paths; the plugin name alone does not define that scope.

shape.reservation: Freeze the currently owned active reservation during preparation; do not reuse a stale value by assumption.

proposed_first_observation.job_ownership: Reuse the reviewed actual UID/process/birth/step/ledger and request-versus-allocation checks. Save partial raw metadata before refusing any missing or contradictory identity.
installed_program_discovery: Read only bounded ordinary systemd unit candidates and their drop-in files, retaining symlink chains and exact ExecStart tokens; do not call systemctl or inspect other process records.

Observe all slurmd/slurmstepd/scontrol candidates from those units and the captured PATH without executing them. Capture canonical path, full directory chain, owner/mode, regular-file identity, size, SHA256 and ELF build ID/DT_NEEDED/RPATH/RUNPATH using a passive parser. Do not use ldd.

Capture bounded package-database ownership/version/build metadata and exact installed manual bytes for those same files. A package label alone does not prove a vendor-patched binary equals the upstream tag. Record unsupported or custom builds explicitly.

Capture only ordinary installed plugin files selected by the observed PluginDir and version: GRES/GPU, cgroup, auth/hash; hash bytes without dlopen. Capture NVIDIA management library file/link metadata only, without loading it or opening devices. No recursive broad package scan.
configuration: Retain before/after hashes and descriptor-bound file/path metadata for actual slurm.conf/gres.conf/cgroup.conf and only their version-correct bounded Include expansion. Preserve observed UID64030 and the actual service-user fields. Do not pretend these are root owned.

Record exact Include tokens/order/expansions and only non-secret relevant values: node identity/Gres, GresTypes, PluginDir, SlurmUser/SlurmdUser, SlurmdSpoolDir/log/pid paths, CgroupPlugin, task/proctrack settings and AutoDetect. Never read private keys or publish AuthInfo/credential values. Unknown escaping/globs, inaccessible includes, cycles, count/size limits or changes make the result incomplete.
Recommended bounds:64 included ordinary files,1MiB per file,64MiB total;32 service drop-in files/64KiB each; each bound has an explicit exceeded/error record and no success inference.
existing_runtime_roster: If the observed SlurmdLogFile or an explicitly listed ordinary node startup record is readable, copy only bounded recognized startup GRES records tied to the saved/current exact node daemon start, preserving line offsets/order and window hash. Retain only node GRES/configuration fields; do not expose other users job records.

A missing/inaccessible/rotated log, absent GRES debug records, incomplete startup window or unbound daemon generation is an explicit unresolved result. Never scan an unbounded journal or broaden into other process/job queries.

A complete existing daemon startup File roster may clarify the running-daemon configuration without a new NVML call. Its source/binary/generation and actual current configuration still need independent review; it grants no job assignment or admission.
proposed_first_observation.command_policy: No slurmd -G, -C, daemon-start/reconfigure options, plugin loading, NVML/CUDA/device calls, privilege changes, other-process queries, controller mutations or configuration writes. A possible future exact-path slurmd -V is a separate small child only after its installed manual/ELF dependencies and exact-version early-exit path are reviewed; it is not needed for the initial passive byte capture.
proposed_first_observation.output: New immutable standard packet with zero credit, version/binary/manual/package/config/startup evidence, raw read errors and an explicit unresolved_fields list. Preserve both old units and every failed observation unchanged.

minimum_review: Actual installed executable and all loaded plugin/library identities, matching manual/source/build, exact Include tree and stable config hashes.

Exact reviewed call graph before GRES print, including logging/stepd notifications, hwloc caches, cgroup/systemd scope/controller migration, authentication/config fetching and plugin constructors. No assumption that unprivileged permission failure makes an attempted write read only.

If any pre-print branch can write daemon/cgroup state, contact other jobs, fetch configuration or cannot be bounded, keep -G blocked. Prefer a readable existing daemon roster or a separately reviewed supported read-only interface. Do not work around this with synthetic GRES/CgroupPlugin/NodeName or configuration files.

If later independently shown eligible, bind one fresh exact owned zero-GPU step, exact installed argv and environment, capture stdout/stderr concurrently with bounded complete output, no retry and ordinary exit/signal/timeout. A wrapper timeout may stop only its exact own child, never the Slurm daemon or another process.

Exit0 alone never passes. Error severity, omitted devices, unknown messages, duplicates, truncated output, unsupported MIG/MultipleFiles, source/config changes or incomplete post-merge record boundaries leave the result unresolved.

Retain the complete ordered post-merge GPU records exactly as printed. Never sort by PCI/NVML/minor, never rename printed Index to scheduler index, never infer bitmap position without the exact matching source/iteration proof.

A reconstructed diagnostic roster is not automatically the running daemon generation. Leave physical_gres_mapping_verified false unless independent source/config/generation and fresh owned job/step/same-process physical identity proofs separately pass.
